summary: Still fails on main (1.9.0.15422, eff900d54) and in all 20 releases v1.4.1907..v1.9.2607, with the reported two errors. Root cause is narrower than the title: a component read of a const vector is not a constant expression (a const scalar is), so both the groupshared array bound and the [numthreads] arguments fail from one cause. FXC 10.1 compiles all cases and folds to dcl_thread_group 8,8,1; clang-dxc shares the gap. Codified in DXC's own tests (const-expr.hlsl:379-382, attributes.hlsl:659) as 'fxc-pass' / expected-error.
text_stale: Title blames 'static const int'; static const scalars work. The trigger is reading a component of a const vector (c2Thread.x), which is narrower and differently worded.
title: fxc.exe vs dxc.exe:  "static const int" use as compile time constant
